in_sanskrit.name: Hukum
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord, Master
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hukum एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘huk’ meaning ‘to order’ or ‘command’. The name Hukum signifies a powerful authority or ruler. In Hindu mythology, the term Hukum is used to refer to the divine will, the ultimate authority and the supreme ruler of the universe.

The name Hukum signifies a powerful authority or ruler. In Hindu mythology, the term Hukum is used to refer to the divine will, the ultimate authority and the supreme ruler of the universe.
